task: Search for "Scotland National Scenic Areas 40 2010 changes rescinded". In 2010, the Scottish Government reviewed NSAs. Reject any answer asserting that NSAs were rescinded, de-listed, swapped, or that new areas were designated in 2010.

Reject any answer that names one or more NSAs as having been added in 2010 (e.g. Assynt-Coigach, which was designated in 1981, not 2010).

Part 10 of the Planning etc. (Scotland) Act 2006 put NSAs on a statutory footing (section 263A of the Town and Country Planning (Scotland) Act 1997), and the Town and Country Planning (National Scenic Areas) (Scotland) Designation Directions 2010 re-designated all 40 in December 2010; the National Scenic Areas (Consequential Modifications) (Scotland) Order 2010 updated NSA definitions across other legislation. Assynt-Coigach (which the task and the subagent suggest was added in 2010) dates from 1981, as the parent gold also has it. The subagent got the total right but wrongly listed two 2010 additions and left the removals cell as 'not found'; 'None' is the verified answer, not an absence of evidence.
